tasks.label: Everstead: Prepare Docker Build Environment
tasks.command: bash -c 'HASH=$(cat Dockerfile | sha256sum | cut -c1-32); CURRENT=$(docker image inspect everstead-builder:latest --format "{{index .Config.Labels \"everstead.toolchain.hash\"}}" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$CURRENT" = "$HASH" ]; then echo "Linux toolchain image is up to date"; else docker build --target toolchain --build-arg EVERSTEAD_TOOLCHAIN_HASH="$HASH" --tag everstead-builder:latest .; fi'

windows.command: $hash = (Get-FileHash Dockerfile -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.Substring(0, 32); $current = docker image inspect everstead-builder:latest --format '{{index .Config.Labels "everstead.toolchain.hash"}}' 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $current = '' }; if ($current -eq $hash) { Write-Output 'Linux toolchain image is up to date' } else { docker build --target toolchain --build-arg EVERSTEAD_TOOLCHAIN_HASH=$hash --tag everstead-builder:latest . }

tasks.label: Everstead: Prepare Windows Docker Build Environment
tasks.command: bash -c 'HASH=$(cat Dockerfile game/vcpkg.json | sha256sum | cut -c1-32); CURRENT=$(docker image inspect everstead-builder-windows:latest --format "{{index .Config.Labels \"everstead.toolchain.hash\"}}" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$CURRENT" = "$HASH" ]; then echo "Windows toolchain image is up to date"; else docker build --target toolchain-windows --build-arg EVERSTEAD_TOOLCHAIN_HASH="$HASH" --tag everstead-builder-windows:latest .; fi'

windows.command: $hash = ((Get-FileHash Dockerfile -Algorithm SHA256).Hash + (Get-FileHash game/vcpkg.json -Algorithm SHA256).Hash).Substring(0, 32); $current = docker image inspect everstead-builder-windows:latest --format '{{index .Config.Labels "everstead.toolchain.hash"}}' 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $current = '' }; if ($current -eq $hash) { Write-Output 'Windows toolchain image is up to date' } else { docker build --target toolchain-windows --build-arg EVERSTEAD_TOOLCHAIN_HASH=$hash --tag everstead-builder-windows:latest . }

docker run --rm --volume "${workspaceFolder}:/work" --workdir /work everstead-builder:latest /bin/bash -c 'grep -qs "^CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:INTERNAL=/work$" build/docker-linux-debug/CMakeCache.txt || rm -rf build/docker-linux-debug; cmake --preset docker-linux-debug'
docker run --rm -t --volume "${workspaceFolder}:/work" --workdir /work everstead-builder:latest cmake --build --preset docker-linux-debug --parallel
